tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 unknown non-Markdown candidates fail closed with provenance$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the unknown non-Markdown candidate reaches no active, historical, or error site.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with one classification error carrying the exact pattern, artifact, line, and unknown-role reason.
tests.negativeControl: Place identical command bytes in unknown Markdown and non-Markdown text artifacts. Both must produce equivalent provenance-bearing error sites, while NUL-bearing binary input remains excluded.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 direct arbitrary wrappers fail closed with provenance
tests.description: A direct custom-wrapper prefix before Node must produce unsupported-wrapper with exact provenance. A direct Node control remains valid and the execution canary remains absent.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 direct arbitrary wrappers fail closed with provenance$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because direct arbitrary-wrapper detection is restricted to table and command-label presentations.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with unsupported-wrapper:custom-wrapper, exact provenance, a valid direct Node control, and an absent canary.
tests.negativeControl: Hold the Node command and glob constant while adding one arbitrary prefix token. The wrapped form must refuse and the unwrapped control must remain valid.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 Markdown-list arbitrary wrappers fail closed with provenance
tests.description: A Markdown-list custom-wrapper prefix before Node must reach the same unsupported-wrapper classification as the direct presentation.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 Markdown-list arbitrary wrappers fail closed with provenance$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the list presentation returns null before classification.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with a provenance-bearing unsupported-wrapper error and the direct list control preserved.
tests.negativeControl: Hold the list marker, Node command, and glob constant while adding one arbitrary prefix token. Only the wrapper classification changes.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 task-list commands reach fail-closed classification
tests.description: Checked and unchecked Markdown task-list markers must be removed as presentation syntax before command parsing, with each unknown candidate classified independently.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 task-list commands reach fail-closed classification$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the task marker remains the apparent executable and hides the Node candidate.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with checked and unchecked task-list candidates classified separately with exact artifact and line provenance.
tests.negativeControl: Compare a plain list item with checked and unchecked task-list forms over identical Node command bytes. All three must reach the same authority classifier.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 table backtick substitutions stay visible and inert
tests.description: A table command with an internal backtick substitution must retain the complete Node command and fail closed for shell substitution without executing the canary.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 table backtick substitutions stay visible and inert$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because table code-span projection drops the Node glob before shell classification.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with the full candidate reported as malformed for backtick substitution and an absent execution canary.
tests.negativeControl: Keep one whole-cell Markdown code span valid, then move a backtick pair inside a longer Node command. Only the internal pair triggers shell-substitution refusal.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-006 quoted pipes in table commands preserve positional globs
tests.description: A pipe inside the quoted test-name-pattern value must remain shell data so the later positional glob reaches classification with exact provenance.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-006 quoted pipes in table commands preserve positional globs$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because naive table splitting divides the quoted alternation and loses the positional glob.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with the quoted option value intact and the exact positional glob classified with artifact and line provenance.
tests.negativeControl: Move the same pipe outside the balanced quote. The structural pipe splits cells, while the quoted pipe stays inside one command.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 Command labels preserve backtick-substitution candidates
tests.description: A Command-label value with internal backticks must retain the complete Node command through shell-substitution refusal without executing its canary.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-005 Command labels preserve backtick-substitution candidates$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because command-label code-span projection hides the Node glob.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with the complete malformed candidate, exact provenance, and an absent execution canary.
tests.negativeControl: Compare a whole-value Markdown code span with a longer labeled command containing internal backticks. Only the whole-value delimiter is unwrapped.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 Perl alarm grammar rejects trailing statements
tests.description: The repository Perl alarm wrapper accepts only the canonical alarm and optional exact failure clause. Any trailing statement produces unsupported-perl-wrapper with provenance.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-002 Perl alarm grammar rejects trailing statements$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the open or-die tail admits an appended Perl statement as active authority.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with unsupported-perl-wrapper for the appended statement, both canonical controls retained, and no candidate execution.
tests.negativeControl: Hold the timeout, Node command, and glob constant across the bare canonical script, exact canonical failure clause, and one extra trailing statement. Only the extra statement refuses.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-004 escaped declaration symlinks refuse instead of skipping
tests.description: An active-plan directory symlink resolving outside the canonical root must raise a containment refusal with its logical artifact path. A regular in-root plan remains active.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-004 escaped declaration symlinks refuse instead of skipping$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because recursive discovery silently omits the symlink and returns no refusal.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with a provenance-bearing outside-root refusal and a regular in-root active-plan control.
tests.negativeControl: Hold active-plan bytes constant while replacing only the in-root directory with an outside-resolving symlink. The regular directory classifies active and the symlink refuses.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 named static node:test imports remain test-bearing
tests.description: A real named static node:test import passes Node execution, remains an orphan without authority, becomes reachable with authority, and never receives the shared-helper exemption.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 named static node:test imports remain test-bearing$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the static import scan stops at the opening brace and grants a helper exemption.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 after Node execution passes, missing authority produces an orphan, matching authority reaches it, and a true helper remains exempt.
tests.negativeControl: Hold file path and importer constant while replacing the named import with no node:test registration. Only the true helper may remain exempt.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 template-interpolated node:test imports remain test-bearing
tests.description: A dynamic node:test import inside executable template interpolation passes Node execution and remains test-bearing, while identical static template text stays helper-only.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 template-interpolated node:test imports remain test-bearing$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because the lexer discards executable interpolation with the surrounding template text.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 after Node execution passes, interpolation remains orphanable and reachable, and static template text remains exempt.
tests.negativeControl: Move identical import bytes between static template text and one executable interpolation expression. Only the interpolation form may register a test.

tests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 regex literals mentioning node:test remain helper-exempt
tests.description: An imported helper whose only node:test spelling is inside a regular-expression body must remain exempt, while a real dynamic import control remains test-bearing.
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='^Regression: SCN-BUG022-008 regex literals mentioning node:test remain helper-exempt$' tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs
tests.expectedRed: Exit 1 because regex-body text is tokenized as executable import syntax and creates a false orphan.
tests.expectedGreen: Exit 0 with the regex-only helper exempt and a real dynamic-import control still test-bearing.
tests.negativeControl: Move identical import spelling between a regex body and a real dynamic import expression. Only the executable expression may create registration.
